occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Of the four children's records evaluated, one lacked the name, address and phone number of the child's doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission (26 TAC §747.605(10))

occurrences.finding: HRC42.054 - Required Fees: The operation has past due fees for background checks. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.054 - Required Fees (26 TAC §HRC42.054 - Required Fees)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation: A background check for an asukt household member has not been submitted. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation (26 TAC §745.621(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The emergency medical information for each child being transported is not in the vehicle. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §747.5417(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Of the four children's records evaluated, one lacked authorization for emergency care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: Training in the following topics were not received for the July 2023-July 2024 training year: emergency preparedness, communicable diseases including immunizations, food allergies, administering medications, understanding building nd physical premises safety and handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers: The emergency telephone numbers for each child being transported is not in the vehicle. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §747.5417(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: Background checks for a no longer affiliated with the operation has not been inactivated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: One assistant carerigver has not completed a pediatriac First Aid and CPR class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605: A background check for an assistant caregiver has not been submitted. The assistant caregiver has access to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605 (26 TAC §745.621(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers - Orientation: The assistant caregiver has not completed an orienattion to the childcare home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers - Orientation (26 TAC §747.1303(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records: The personnel records for the assistant caregivers is lacking the following information:  1. Hire date  2. How they meet the ediucation requirements  3. Notarized affidavit  4. Copy of driver's license
